examples.arabic: أمي بتقولي إن اختيار الفستان زي اختيار رئيس الجمهورية صعب
examples.english: My mom tells me that choosing the dress is as difficult as choosing the President of the Republic.
examples.transliteration: Ommi betʾūli en ekhtiyār el-fostān zayy ekhtiyār raʾīs el-gomhūrīya ṣaʿb.

examples.arabic: مهم نختار رئيس الجمهورية اللي يقود البلد كويس
examples.english: It's important to choose the President of the Republic who will lead the country well.
examples.transliteration: Mohimm nekhtār raʾīs el-gomhūrīya elli yaʾūd el-balad kwayyis.

examples.arabic: هي سألتني تفتكر مين هيكسب وهل رئيس الجمهورية الحالي هيترشح تاني
examples.english: She asked me "Who do you think will win and will the current President of the Republic run again?"
examples.transliteration: Heyya saʾaletni "Teftiker mīn hayeksab w hal raʾīs el-gomhūrīya el-ḥāli hayetrashshaḥ tāni?"

examples.arabic: زمان كان التصويت ده حاجة مهمة والناس كلها بتشارك عشان تختار رئيس الجمهورية
examples.english: Back in the day, voting was something important, and everyone participated to choose the President of the Republic.
examples.transliteration: Zamān kān et-taṣwīt da ḥaga mohimma w en-nās kolaha betshārek ʿashān tekhtār raʾīs el-gomhūrīya.

examples.arabic: خالتي بتحب تتكلم عن الاخبار السياسية وعن رئيس الجمهورية
examples.english: My aunt loves to talk about political news and about the President of the Republic.
examples.transliteration: Khalti betḥebb tetkallem ʿan el-akhbār es-siyāsīya wa ʿan raʾīs el-gomhūrīya.

examples.arabic: الراجل الكبير كان بيقول ان التصويت مهم جدا لاختيار رئيس الجمهورية
examples.english: The old man was saying that voting is very important for choosing the President of the Republic.
examples.transliteration: Er-ragel el-kebīr kān beyʾūl en et-taṣwīt mohem geddan lakhṭīyār raʾīs el-gomhūrīya
